text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Classification: observed first-reported cash flows. Oracle is a Dec-Nov quarter-end proxy.
Cash CapEx excludes finance lease additions and lease principal; it includes non-AI purchases.
Aggregate coverage does not imply that cash can be transferred between companies. Missing values stay missing.
Source: captured SEC companyfacts; company-quarterly-source.csv and source-register.json. Cutoff: Oct 8, 2026.
A ratio above 100% is a narrow coverage observation; it does not establish distress or a complete financing need.
